scenes.event: William arranges a symbolic gesture to express his feelings to Yury through a public online event
scenes.description: William is nervously seated at a bench near a fountain, watching a group of students set up a small, interactive online event in the courtyard. The event is a live stream for a gaming charity marathon, and William has arranged a symbolic gesture of red roses in the background to catch Yury’s attention when she logs in.

characters.name: William Bell
characters.description: An early 25-year-old college student, visibly anxious but determined. He wears a hoodie and has a small notebook with scribbled notes on how to handle the situation.; male, early, 25 years old; Occupation: College Student; Personality: Anxious, Sensitive, Empathetic, Reserved; Values: Friendship, Emotional sincerity, Trust; Interests: Online communication, Gaming, Romantic gestures; Experiences: Dealing with unrequited feelings, Planning symbolic gestures, Waiting for emotional response

characters.name: Yury Kim
characters.description: A 24-year-old fellow student and William’s close friend. She’s known for her sharp wit and love for online gaming. She enters the courtyard, scanning the setup with curiosity; Female; Age: 24; Occupation: Game design major; Personality: Curious, friendly, witty, empathetic, observant; Values: Honesty, creativity, loyalty; Interests: Online multiplayer games, indie music, digital art; Experiences: Participated in a university game jam, volunteered for a gaming charity stream, formed a close-knit group of friends through online role-playing games.

characters.name: Lina Ting
characters.description: A 23-year-old William’s confidante and fellow student. She’s tech-savvy and organized, helping William coordinate the event setup and ensuring the roses are visible in the stream; Female; Age: 23; Occupation: Computer Science student and part-time social media manager for campus events; Personality: Analytical, empathetic, proactive; Values: Honesty, collaboration, creative expression; Interests: Event planning, streaming technology, indie music; Experiences: Organized a successful campus hackathon, volunteered for a digital outreach campaign for a local charity, helped friends execute surprise proposals through social media.

actions.action: Nervously checks his phone for messages
actions.dialogue: I just hope she logs in soon. I don’t want to wait too long and have the stream go live without her seeing it.
You did everything right, William. She’ll see the roses. Just take a deep breath and remember why you care about her.

actions.action: Notices the roses and approaches William with a smile
actions.dialogue: William, what’s this? The roses are beautiful. Is this for the stream?

actions.action: Looks up, slightly flustered, and nods
actions.dialogue: Yeah, I thought it would be a nice way to add a personal touch. I mean, we’ve been friends for so long, and I just wanted to show it somehow.

actions.action: Examines the roses and smiles knowingly
actions.dialogue: You always were the sentimental one. I get it, William. This is beautiful. I’ll make sure to log in early and catch the moment.

actions.action: Gives William a thumbs-up from the side
actions.dialogue: She gets it. You’re a good friend, and this is just part of who you are.

scenes.plot: William arranges a symbolic gesture of red roses for a live stream event, hoping Yury will see and understand his feelings. Lina supports him, and Yury’s reaction is warm and understanding, affirming their friendship and giving William hope.
scenes.social_purpose: Show William’s values of friendship and emotional sincerity through his symbolic gesture. Demonstrate his personality traits (anxious, sensitive, empathetic) and his reliance on Lina for validation.

chunk.text: William nervously checks his phone while Lina helps prepare the stream setup. Yury arrives, notices the roses, and engages William in a friendly conversation about their meaning. William’s anxiety is evident, but his sincerity shines through as he shares his intentions.
